question: Should ClawHub sponsor a revised declared-capability contract, and what schema, precedence, authority, and advisory rollout should replace the earlier blocked implementation?
rationale: This creates a public security and API contract; repository evidence cannot choose the permanent taxonomy, whether declarations are authoritative or informational, or when legacy skills should be required to adopt it.

options.title: Sponsor revised advisory schema
options.body: Define a minimal versioned schema, preserve current API fields, separate declared from observed capabilities, and initially treat missing or mismatched declarations as non-blocking review signals.

options.title: Extend existing requirements only
options.body: Add narrowly scoped fields to requires, envVars, and install metadata without introducing a general capability taxonomy.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Continue using current metadata and artifact-based scanner inference until a broader ecosystem capability standard settles.

recommendation.title: Sponsor revised advisory schema
recommendation.body: Define a minimal versioned schema, preserve current API fields, separate declared from observed capabilities, and initially treat missing or mismatched declarations as non-blocking review signals.

likelyOwner.reason: This person made the prior landing decision and explicitly identified the compatibility conditions needed before the direction could ship.
